attributes.board_name: Nebraska Board of Medicine and Surgery (DHHS Licensure Unit)

topics.who: Professionals who prescribe controlled substances; 0.5 of the 3 hours must cover the Prescription Drug Monitoring Program (PDMP)

rules.notes: MD and DO (osteopathic physician and surgeon) licenses are both issued through the DHHS medicine and surgery program. All licenses expire October 1 of every even year regardless of issue date. Free DHHS videos cover the opioid/PDMP hours.
rules.legal_basis: 172 NAC 10; Neb. Rev. Stat. §38-145(6) (LB 731, opioid CE)
